headline: Pal Surgery Table
title: Pal Surgery Table | Change Passive Skills With Implants | Palworld Guide
video_script: Want better passive skills without endless breeding in Palworld one point zero? Build the Pal Surgery Table in your base. It lets you add or replace a Pal's passive skills using implants. A Pal holds four passives, and a new one can overwrite an old one, so choose carefully. Implants come from sources like Bounty Officers, who take Successful Bounty Tokens. Will you operate on your best Pal? Comment below!
description: The Pal Surgery Table in Palworld 1.0 lets you add or replace Pal passive skills using implants, including ones from Bounty Officers.
joke: The only thing sharper than the scalpel is the price tag.
